additional_info.subject: RE: ID0466836-DC/Si-D/FR-[Y2 / R9 313202799118] OCPP offline CRM:03055000432
additional_info.body:
Hello Francisco,
I am very interested in this topic and how we are going to approach it.
Our SIM card provider is Telenor Denmark, which is an international provider that only offers roaming services in our country.
So it is indeed the modem that chooses the telephone operator, which means that either the signal is poor, or we simply lose communication.
Please look into this matter thoroughly.
Yan Spano from our company tells me that you speak French. That would be very helpful to me, as I only do translations and don't speak English :)
Thank you
Cédric SCHOEPFF

additional_info.subject: ID0466836-DC/Si-D/FR-[Y2 / R9 313202799118] OCPP offline CRM:03055000432
additional_info.body:
Hello Cedric, good afternoon.
Unfortunately, I believe you are refering to François, not Francisco, he is indeed French but no longer part of the team. We can continue with the translation, this is pretty normal in our activities.
From my side I can only offer you one solution which is to revert the router to factory settings and try to see if it gets improved.
There are not a lot of configurations that can be checked here since it's SIM card, we enable it and besides the APN, no extra configurations should be needed.
Please let me know if you still want to go forward with the factory reset.
If after the reset , the problem persists in the same way, unfortunately, we do not have any other possibility besides changing the SIM card because the Vodafone SIM card for the SCB seems to be working perfectly fine:
Besides the RSRP being a bit worse than expected the rest of the signals are Excellent and Good.
From yesterday I see that the connectivity has improved a little bit:
I will wait for your feedback.
Best regards,
Francisco

additional_info.subject: ID0466836-DC/Si-D/FR-[Y2 / R9 313202799118] OCPP offline CRM:03055000432
additional_info.body:
Hello Cedric,
Since it's holiday season, I assume that I won't be getting a reply soon.
As such, I will close the ticket, from our side, honestly, the router seems to be working fine and it's related to Network Provider coverage.
I would suggest trying another SIM card, from the Siemens backend, we use Vodafone and the signal is very good.
Thank you and wish you a Happy New Year!
Best regards,
Francisco
